description: Prepares a listing for sale of a card the user owns (dealId from record_purchase, or cardId) on their connected selling account with its business policies. Nothing is listed yet. Returns the price (default: the 3 most recent sales average for a slab, the market price for a raw card; pass price to change it), quantity, the photo count with a one-time photo upload link (30 minutes) and a publishToken (15 minutes). Read the summary question to the user ("List <card> at $X with N photos?"). When photos.count is above 0 the photos are saved: do not ask the user for more. To add or change photos the user uses the photo panel where one is shown, otherwise the uploadUrl; after photos change, call prepare_listing again before publish_listing. If the selling account isn't connected, the message says how. Where the assistant shows panels, the result opens a photo panel where the user can take the card's photo for the listing. If the result has alerts, show them to the user before anything else.

cardId.description: Or a card in the user's collection.

price.description: The listing price in USD (default: the suggested price).

quantity.description: Raw cards: how many to list (default 1).

title.description: A listing title (default: built from the card).

name: prepare_listing
title: Prepare a listing
